# MH-05 — Provide party requirements

**Business value:** 970

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker

I want to specify dietary restrictions and allergies for people in my party

So that the hut can prepare suitable meals safely


## Notes

In case of allergies a flag must be checked to notify that special care is needed during the preparation.
The details are described in a text field.
Multiple requirements can be specified for subsets of the party

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

The allergies flags can be simply a checkbox to be selected in case of allergies to make explicit that it is an important issue.
